item.title: 📄 The Intrinsic Scatter of the Radial Acceleration Relation
item.description: A statistical analysis of the intrinsic scatter in the Radial Acceleration Relation (RAR), placing tight constraints on the universality of the baryonic-to-total acceleration connection in late-type galaxies.
